info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Electrical Engineering

subTitleDesc.sub_title_en: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the properties, characterization, and applications of materials used in microwave and radio frequency (RF) engineering. Students will study the dielectric, magnetic, and conductive properties of various materials and their impact on microwave device performance. Emphasis is placed on material selection for microwave circuits, antennas, and passive/active devices, along with techniques for material analysis at high frequencies.

description.describe_ch: 本課程的目標在培養相關領域學生的微波材料科學、基礎理論與知識、並能從材料分析角度強化微波技術相關應用，藉由設計、製程、分析、量測及應用開發先進微波應用技術。
description.describe_eh: The goal of this course is to train students in related fields of microwave material science, basic theory and knowledge, and to strengthen the application. From the perspective of material analysis, and to develop advanced microwave technology application through design, manufacturing, analysis, measurement.

targets.describe_en: To understand the concept of material science

targets.describe_ch: 協助學生開發應用於微波技術與元件之微波材料。
targets.describe_en: To understand the material of microwave technology and device

weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Definition of microwave (300 MHz–300 GHz), wave-material interactions, and application areas (radar, communication, sensing, etc.)
Dielectric constant (ε), magnetic permeability (μ), loss tangent (tan δ), and electrical conductivity (σ); frequency dependence
Complex dielectric functions, Kramers–Kronig relations, group and phase velocity in materials
Plane wave reflection/transmission at interfaces; VSWR, impedance matching concepts
Attenuation constant, conductor loss, dielectric loss, skin depth and practical implications
Introduction to ceramics (low/high ε), ferrites, polymers, conductive and composite materials
Resonant cavity techniques for ε_r and Q factor extraction, perturbation theory

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Measurement Techniques II: Transmission Line & Free-Space Methods
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Coaxial/microstrip-based ε_r and tan δ extraction, S-parameter inversion, free-space methods

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en: Lab Case Study I: Dielectric Constant & Loss Measurement
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Practical session using VNA and resonant structures to extract dielectric properties
Case studies: BaTiO₃, ZrSnTiO₄, and other high-frequency low-loss materials; structure-property relationships
Low- and high-temperature co-fired ceramics, integration and packaging techniques for RF modules
Ferromagnetic resonance (FMR), permeability spectra, ferrites in isolators, circulators, and antennas
Properties and challenges of polymers (e.g., PTFE, LCP) and polymer-ceramic composites in microwave applications
Material selection for antenna substrates, design trade-offs, Rogers materials, impact on impedance and radiation
Material design for filters, BAW/SAW/FBAR structures, electromechanical coupling (k²), and Q considerations
Materials for 5G/6G (e.g., Sc-doped AlN, high ε with low loss), thin films, MEMS-compatible substrates
Group presentations: Material characterization, measurement methods, and design challenges (in English)
Oral presentations with Q&A covering material integration, measurement techniques, and application scenarios
